notes: All 22 full bodies were checked through their own title, subject/scope, application/repeal clauses and relevant UN reference clauses. Existing summary updates were not re-reported. All proposed dates distinguish adoption/signature from legal application or entry into force. General product instruments can correctly have no vehicle categories. The 2021/535 UN-equivalent list contains several definition and test-method references; exact list correction was skipped because its overarching UN approval provisions make partial-adoption interpretation material. No new UN equivalent was proposed.

Where both entry into force and general application are given, effective_date proposals use the general application date. This is a repository convention choice: the current adoption date is neither, but entry-into-force dates are also legally valid dates and the orchestrator should adjudicate the convention. For 2006/40/EC and 2014/53/EU the proposed date is when Member States apply transposing measures, rather than EU-level directive entry into force.
